minutes.headline: Assessors reviewed the draft Vision property-card guide and approved amended Dec 18 minutes; no budget votes were taken.
minutes.summary: The Board of Assessors met on Jan 8, 2024 with the interim principal assessor working alone in the office. They heard a status report, reviewed the draft "how to read your Vision card" guide, and discussed website outreach and the March presentation. They approved the amended Dec 18 minutes, signed invoices, and planned January and February meetings.

public_comment.topic: Chair asked for public comment in the room and on Zoom; none was offered.
Closing public comment requested; no hands were raised.

votes.motion: Remove the assessment reconciliation item from the Dec 18 minutes and approve the amended minutes.
Accept the recommendations in the board's note to the town manager on the FY budget, staffing and education (with added wording on courses and conferences).

budget_items.what_was_said: Several invoices from Vision were presented for signature, with concern that some may already have been paid or duplicated because they were emailed to staff who are absent.

budget_items.topic: Continuing education and conferences in the assessor budget
budget_items.what_was_said: The board discussed a note to the town manager on the next fiscal year budget, adding money for courses, certification credits and conferences. The current line amount was unknown, and staff would research comparable towns.

budget_items.topic: Cost of Q&A session with the Vision consultant
budget_items.what_was_said: A member asked what a Q&A session would cost per day, and was told it is not the board's contract and not appropriate to discuss now.
It was said that land beyond the primary site is currently valued as excess land at a per-acre rate.

budget_items.topic: Exemption amounts on town document versus state
budget_items.what_was_said: Members noted that exemption figures on the town's document did not match the state's, and a town meeting vote can double the amount.
It was said the vendor's advanced query product was costly and beyond the assessors' needs, and belongs to the other departments' contract base.

decisions.decision: Chapter land hearings to be on Jan 29 in open session, and senior and veteran exemptions on Jan 22 in executive session.
Board will drop establishing ad hoc committees from new business for now; a member will check how the planning board set theirs up.
A member will try to schedule a Q&A session with the consultant on a Thursday in early February.
Next regular meetings noted: Jan 22 (exemptions), Jan 29, Feb 5, and Feb 12 tentatively.
Exemption increase implications discussion kept on the agenda as current business.
The Vision card guide will use dollar-per-square-foot for a limited list of items instead of percentages.
